questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead is now divided. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow traffic light mean?
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: Worn or bald tires:
questions.explanation: Worn tires make turning harder and increase stopping distance. Tires with little tread also cause hydroplaning in wet conditions.

questions.question: If you miss your exit on the interstate, you should:

options.text: Quickly cut across traffic to make your turn.
Make a U-turn to go back to the exit.
Continue driving and use the next exit.
Put your vehicle in reverse to go back to the exit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue driving and use the next exit.
questions.explanation: Don't make a sudden turn at a missed exit. Keep driving and take the next exit instead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks reserved parking spaces. These spaces are for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license plate.

questions.question: A steady green light at an intersection means:

options.text: Must slow down and prepare to stop.
Must stop and check for oncoming traffic before proceeding.
May drive through the intersection if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: May drive through the intersection if the road is clear.
questions.explanation: A steady green light means you can go through the intersection if it is safe. You may also turn right or left unless a sign says you cannot. Always yield to other vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection.

questions.question: You are driving uphill and approaching a heavy truck from behind. You should know:

options.text: The truck may be traveling slower than the speed limit.
You may not be able to safely pass the truck.
You may not be able to legally pass the truck.

questions.explanation: Heavy trucks often go slower than the speed limit on hills. You may not have a safe or legal place to pass. Use caution when approaching large vehicles.

questions.question: You must stop at an intersection when you see:
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop, look both ways, and only go when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about construction zones. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead and will direct traffic. Follow their instructions.

questions.question: If you drink alcohol socially, how can you ensure safe driving?

options.text: Ride home with a friend who has not been drinking.
Take a cold shower before driving.
Stop drinking one half hour before driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ride home with a friend who has not been drinking.
questions.explanation: The best way to drive safely is to arrange a ride with a friend who is not drinking. Coffee and cold showers do not reduce alcohol in your system. It takes about one hour for your body to process one drink.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you there is a sharp turn ahead and you should reduce your speed.

questions.question: It starts to rain while you are driving. What should you do?

options.text: Drive at the maximum speed limit.
Drive close behind the vehicle ahead of you.

questions.explanation: When it rains, reduce your speed. Turn on your headlights so other drivers can see you. If rain is very heavy and you cannot see clearly, move to the shoulder and stop until the rain stops.

questions.question: Another driver cuts you off in traffic. What should you do?

options.text: Pull next to the driver and yell at them.
Flash your high beams at the driver.
Cut them off to get back at them.

questions.explanation: Do not take road conflicts personally. If another driver cuts you off, let it go and keep driving safely. This helps prevent road rage.

questions.question: Drivers who have consumed alcohol before driving:

options.text: Always know the risks they are taking.
Cannot control their body, mind, or vehicle properly.
Are better drivers because they drive more carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cannot control their body, mind, or vehicle properly.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your judgment, vision, concentration, and reaction time. It is never safe to drive after drinking any amount of alcohol.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your vehicle will be towed if you park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: When should you honk your horn?

options.text: When you are traveling through an intersection.
When you are passing a bicyclist.
When you see a child about to run into the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you see a child about to run into the street.
questions.explanation: Use your horn to warn other drivers or pedestrians who do not see you. For example, if a child starts to run into the street in front of your vehicle, use your horn to alert them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they can turn left or continue straight from this lane at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about construction zones. This sign means a flagger is ahead and will direct traffic. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and check for traffic. Proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
Only certain turns are allowed from certain lanes.
Drivers in both lanes must merge safely together.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. Only buses and cars with a driver and one or more passengers can use this lane.

questions.question: You must signal before turning, changing lanes, or leaving a curb because:

options.text: You only need to signal if other cars are nearby.
It is a good habit and the law requires it.
You only need to signal during the move, not before.
You do not need to signal if you move slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is a good habit and the law requires it.
questions.explanation: Signal before turning or changing lanes. The law requires you to signal at least 100 feet before moving your vehicle left or right. Always signal before pulling away from a curb.

questions.question: Taking drugs with alcohol:

options.text: Is no more dangerous than alcohol alone.
Reduces the effects of alcohol on driving.
Does not affect your driving ability.

questions.explanation: Drugs (illegal, prescription, or over-the-counter) can damage your brain function and hurt your driving ability. Mixing alcohol with drugs increases the chance of a crash.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is an intersection ahead where a road joins from the right.

questions.question: When you see a railroad crossing warning sign, you should:

options.text: Be ready to stop if a train is coming.
Find a way around the gates if they are down.
Keep driving normally since no trains are near.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if a train is coming.
questions.explanation: Railroad crossing warning signs alert you that a train might be nearby. Obey all warning signs and barriers. Never go around lowered gates.

questions.question: If you are in an accident, you should:

options.text: Stop at or near the accident scene.
Not stand or walk in traffic lanes.
Turn off the engines of damaged vehicles.

questions.explanation: Stop at or near the accident scene. Move your vehicle out of traffic if possible. Do not stand in traffic lanes where another car could hit you. Turn off the engines of damaged vehicles.

questions.question: You should drive with extra care near a pedestrian with a white cane because:

options.text: The person is a police officer.

questions.explanation: A white cane shows that a person is blind. Slow down, give them the right-of-way, and be ready to stop to avoid hitting them.

questions.question: Double solid yellow lines in the middle of the road mean:

options.text: Passing is not allowed in either direction.
Passing is allowed in either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is not allowed in either direction.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean you cannot pass in either direction. You may cross these lines only to make a left turn or pass pedestrians, cyclists, or scooter riders when it is safe.

questions.question: If you see an animal on the road, you should:

options.text: Pass the animal as close as possible.

questions.explanation: Be very cautious when you see an animal on the road. Pass it slowly to avoid scaring it.

questions.question: You must always signal when:

options.text: Pulling into or out of a parking space.
Pulling into traffic from a parking area or alley.

questions.explanation: Use your turn signals when you move left or right in any way. Signal when entering traffic from a parking space, changing lanes, or passing another vehicle.
